hero.headline:
A Peaceful Stay
in a Haven
of Serenity
hero.subheadline: An exclusive villa set around a riad-inspired patio, 25 minutes from Marrakech.

home.welcome_body: Our suites, arranged around a riad-inspired patio, offer a calm and enchanting setting. Admire the starry sky from the patio, enjoy the fireplace lounge and a dining room seating up to 14 guests. The ethnic, bohemian decor — sourced and customised by Marrakech artisans — creates a warm, elegant atmosphere.
home.suites_sub: Each suite is a world of its own: every hue was chosen to evoke unique emotions, in harmony with Marrakchi craftsmanship.
home.experiences_sub: Traditional hammam, massage room, fitness room, pétanque court, badminton and table tennis — plus the garden with its koi pond and Buddha statue.
home.cta_body: The entire villa, exclusively — 7 bedrooms, sleeping 14. Ideal for family gatherings, golf trips and seminars.

services.page_sub: Dining, wellness and excursions — everything for a carefree stay.

restauration.page_sub: Home cooking and world flavours, prepared with fresh vegetables from the kitchen garden.
restauration.intro: The Villa Serena kitchen is entrusted to a dedicated cook, who prepares every meal from traditional Moroccan family recipes, enriched with flavours from further afield. Vegetables come, whenever possible, from the villa's own kitchen garden — picked that same morning.
highlights: Seasonal vegetables from the villa's own kitchen garden
Meals prepared on request, whenever suits you
Dining room seating up to 14 guests

bienEtre.page_sub: Traditional hammam, black-soap scrubs, massage room and fitness room — an oasis of relaxation and renewal.
bienEtre.intro: After a day of golf, exploring the medina, or simply lounging by the pool, Villa Serena has a real recovery space built in. A traditional hammam, massage room and fitness room are all under one roof — no need to go out to take care of yourself.
highlights: Traditional Moroccan hammam, black-soap scrub and Kessa glove exfoliation
Dedicated massage room, treatments by reservation
Fitness room, free access all day
A team on-site to arrange your treatments

excursions.page_sub: Ourika Valley hikes, horseback riding, quad biking, buggies and hot-air balloon flights.
excursions.intro: Between rounds of golf, the Marrakech region has plenty to explore: the Ourika Valley, the Agafay desert, a sunrise hot-air balloon flight. On-site, the villa's garden has its own diversions too — a pétanque court, badminton and table tennis for family moments.
highlights: Hikes and horseback riding in the Ourika Valley
Quad biking, buggies and hot-air balloon flights with our selected partners
Pétanque court and badminton / table tennis area on-site
Excursions arranged on request, transport included

experiences.page_sub: Yoga retreats, golf and grand celebrations — Villa Serena is yours to hire for exceptional moments.

golf.page_sub: 11 championship courses within 30 minutes — bespoke golf stays.
golf.intro: Villa Serena sits at the heart of Marrakech's golfing constellation — the ideal base camp for a golf trip with friends or family, minutes from courses designed by some of the world's greatest architects.

featured.name: PalmGolf Marrakech Ourika
featured.description: The closest, on the same axis as the villa. With stunning views over the Atlas mountains, Palm Golf Ourika is a must-play course in the region, designed in a desert style by Canadian duo Neil Haworth and Stéphane Talbot.

featured.name: Akenza Golf
featured.description: Marrakech's new jewel (2025). Designed by Kyle Phillips, architect of the legendary Kingsbarns. Canyons and wadis, eight ravine crossings, an anthology-worthy 7th hole.

featured.name: Samanah Country Club
featured.description: The Jack Nicklaus signature. The first course in Africa to host a PGA Champions Tour event. Clubhouse inspired by Marrakech's ramparts.

golf.table_note: Beyond these three nearest greens, eight more courses complete the picture — eleven courses in all, designed by Nicklaus, Kyle Phillips, Robert Trent Jones, Cabell Robinson and Colin Montgomerie, all set against the Atlas mountains.
